in_sanskrit.name: Khimji
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Wisdom, Knowledge
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Khimji एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Khimji is derived from the Sanskrit language, which translates to 'he who knows'. It is a name of wisdom and knowledge, attributed to those who possess deep understanding and insight.
